name: @projexlight/connector-github
summary: GitHub App connector: install at org or repo scope, sync repos / issues / PRs, ingest GitHub webhooks for real-time PR + CI signals. The dev-ops integration backbone — pair with connector-linear/jira for end-to-end engineering workflows or with sdk-workflow for compliance gates on merge.

events.name: connector-github.installation.created.v1
events.description: GitHub App installed at org / user scope.

models.description: Cached PR row with check + review state.

hooks.name: registerInstallation
hooks.description: Persist a GitHub App installation after the user installs from the marketplace.

hooks.name: syncRepos
hooks.description: Sync repo list for an installation.

hooks.name: handleWebhook
hooks.description: Process inbound GitHub webhook (issues, pull_request, check_run, push, etc.).

hooks.name: openPr
hooks.description: Open a PR programmatically (e.g. for a Renovate-style auto-update).

hooks.name: startScheduler
hooks.description: Background worker: re-syncs repo + check state for installations.

scenarios.title: Customer installs the GitHub App at org scope
scenarios.when_to_use: User clicks 'Install' on the GitHub Marketplace listing; GitHub redirects with installation_id; we persist + back-fill repos.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Installation row written + initial syncRepos kicked off. Emits .installation.created.v1.

scenarios.title: PR merged → kick off sdk-workflow deploy gate
scenarios.when_to_use: Inbound webhook on pull_request.closed with merged=true; we surface as .pr.merged.v1 which sdk-workflow consumes to start deploy approvals.
scenarios.example_code:
import { handleWebhook } from '@projexlight/connector-github';
await handleWebhook({ tenant_id, signature, body, event_type: 'pull_request' });
scenarios.expected_outcome: PR cache updated; emits .pr.merged.v1. sdk-workflow advances the linked deploy workflow.

scenarios.title: Failed check posts to Slack + opens Linear issue
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on .check.completed.v1 with conclusion=failure — connector-slack posts to #eng-alerts + connector-linear opens an issue for triage.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Alert + tracking issue created automatically. Both events show up in the audit chain alongside the original check event.

scenarios.title: Auto-update PR opened programmatically
scenarios.when_to_use: Compliance workflow detects an outdated lockfile; opens a PR to update it.
scenarios.expected_outcome: PR opened; PR row written. Subsequent merge/close events flow back through webhooks.

scenarios.title: Scheduler re-syncs check state to backstop webhook drops
scenarios.when_to_use: GitHub occasionally rate-limits or drops webhooks; the scheduler refreshes the recent-PR check state every 15 min so stale UI never lingers.
scenarios.example_code: // driven by startScheduler — periodic refresh of recent PRs.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Stale checks rehydrated; emits .check.completed.v1 only for newly-final checks.

compliance_posture.notes: App private key vault-wrapped via sdk-secrets. Webhook HMAC-SHA256 signature verification mandatory. PR-merged audit chain satisfies SOX change-management requirement when paired with sdk-workflow + sdk-approval.
